description: This Java class 'StatusWorker' provides static methods to query and retrieve status-related data from the database, and to set this data as attributes in a JSP PageContext. It interacts with the entity layer via EntityQuery and handles status items and valid change details.

classes.name: StatusWorker
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to fetch status items and change details, and set them in JSP page context.

methods.name: getStatusItems
methods.description: Fetches a list of status items for a given status type ID and sets it as a page context attribute.

methods.name: getStatusItems
methods.description: Fetches status items for two status type IDs, combines them, and sets as a page context attribute.

methods.name: getStatusValidChangeToDetails
methods.description: Fetches valid change-to details for a given status ID and sets it as a page context attribute.
